entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Ugh, finally. I've been on hold forever. I need to return these useless shoes you sold me. This is ridiculous.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with that today. To get started, could you please provide your order number?
It's VF88602. And don't give me the runaround. I want a full refund, and I want it now. These things are trash.
I understand your frustration, and I'll do my best to resolve this for you quickly. I've pulled up your order. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?

What's the issue? The issue is they're instruments of torture! I've gone on two rides and I have massive blisters on both heels. They're stiff as a board, the cleats are impossible to adjust correctly, and they're completely unusable. I paid good money for these!
I'm very sorry to hear that the fit is causing you blisters and that you're having trouble with the cleats. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers.

You're damn right it's not! I'm not interested in excuses or a different size. I want my money back. If I don't get a refund confirmation on this call, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Is that clear? Get me a manager if you can't do it.

That won't be necessary, I can handle this for you. Let me just confirm the return policy for your order. One moment... Okay, I see here that you received the item 20 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on our cycling shoes within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window.
So? What does that mean? Are you giving me my money back or not?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. You'll be receiving an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label to send the shoes back. Once we receive them, a full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. The email will have all the instructions.
Oh. So... it's done? I'll get a full refund?
Yes, a complete refund. The return authorization number is RA-75119. You'll see that in the email as well.
Well... okay. That was easier than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
